svg.title: Emo Robot Circuit Diagram — ESP32 + SSD1306 OLED + Touch Sensor
svg.desc: Schematic showing ESP32 DevKit connected to SSD1306 OLED via I2C, touch sensor on GPIO4, and power connections
svg.text: Pull-up resistors (4.7kΩ on SDA/SCL) recommended for I2C
if wire length > 30cm. Shorter wires usually work without.
ESP32 internal touch (GPIO4) works without external module — just connect a wire/pad.
